claims.description: Table 5 (adjusted ORs, severe distress): Increased working from home, column Working/other sectors. Code analogue: exp(coef(m1)['workMoreHome'])
Table 5: Increased working from home, column health and welfare sector. Code analogue: exp(coef(m2)['workMoreHome'])
Table 5: Women, column other sectors. Code analogue: exp(coef(m1)['women'])

notes: Claims = first three numbers in Table 5 read row by row (rows: Increased WFH both columns, then Women first column). Known before running: Table 5 says models include survey-month fixed effects and education dummies; the package code m1/m2 has neither and the data file has no education variable, so Table 5 cannot be exactly reproduced from the package as shipped. Run is still performed with the shipped code unchanged (only setwd and .tab->.csv copy).
